hook: Claude Haiku 5.5 slashed token prices by 90 percent.

sections.voiceover: Claude Haiku 5.5 slashed token prices by 90 percent.
sections.visual_cue: Macro shot of a high-end server rack displaying a 90 percent price drop statistic

sections.voiceover: On October 7, 2026, Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 with input pricing at $0.10 per one million tokens.
sections.visual_cue: Animated document showing October 7, 2026 release date and $0.10 pricing metric

sections.voiceover: That score is up 26 points from the previous release.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of output pricing metric chart showing $0.50 per MTok

sections.voiceover: VentureBeat reported that Anthropic hit this 90 percent price cut for requests under 100,000 tokens. Anthropic designed the model with a 1 million token context window and 128,000 maximum output tokens.
sections.visual_cue: Split screen comparison showing 100,000 token threshold and 1 million token context window

sections.voiceover: Claude Haiku 5.5 reached 43 points on Artificial Analysis.
sections.visual_cue: Final scoreboard graphic highlighting 43 intelligence index points
